verdicts.rationale: POST /schema accepts negative desiredCount values (e.g., -1) returning HTTP 200, creating collection with invalid state (desiredVirtualCount=-128). Source code confirms no range validation in optionalIntFromMap() function - it only performs type conversion. Physical constraint (desiredCount ≥ 1 for physical shards) is violated. This matches developer cognition pattern BS-004 (parameter validation gaps at API boundaries). desiredCount=0 correctly fails with 'physical shards unavailable' error, but negative values bypass all validation.
